h1: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 230 m²

blocks.text: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 230 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a comprehensive project for a 230 m² private house, including interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and manufacturing, and turnkey renovation.

The project covers the main functional areas of the house: living room, bedrooms, kitchen with built-in appliances, dressing rooms, entrance hall and bathrooms. The layout and interior solutions were developed with a strong focus on ergonomics, everyday comfort and visual consistency throughout the house.

Custom-made furniture was developed for the individual rooms, including built-in wardrobes, storage systems, shelving and other bespoke furniture elements. Designing the furniture together with the interior makes it possible to take the architecture of each room into account, use the available space efficiently and maintain a consistent style throughout the house.

The project was implemented as a comprehensive process — from the development of the interior concept and technical documentation to renovation works, custom furniture manufacturing and installation. Before implementation, a detailed estimate was prepared covering works, construction and finishing materials, furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment and lighting.
The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations, demonstrating the interior, layout and custom furniture solutions developed for the 230 m² private house.
Today, DUMSKAYA DESIGN is based in Bratislava, Slovakia, providing comprehensive interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation services with a primary focus on Bratislava and Vienna.
